title: Jefrine Correya — Résumé
text:
Jefrine Correya
Cybersecurity & IT Operations Professional
+91 8113064878 | jefrincorreya@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/jefrine07 | jefrine-portfolio.com | Doha, Qatar

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
EC-Council Certified SOC Analyst (CSA) with hands-on experience monitoring security events, triaging alerts, and executing incident handling workflows in continuous operations environments. Proficient in log analysis, case creation, and documenting investigation findings across SIEM and EDR solutions including Splunk, Wazuh, Microsoft Sentinel, and Defender. Skilled in TCP/IP packet analysis, IT infrastructure troubleshooting, and building automated security triage tools using Python. Strong communicator adept at customer notification, stakeholder collaboration, and supporting Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs). Available for shift-based operations and flexible schedules.

SKILLS
• SOC Operations & Triage - 24/7 Alert Monitoring, Incident Triage, Case Management, Incident Escalation, Post-Incident Reviews (PIR), Customer Notification, SLA Adherence
• IT Support & Administration - Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Ticketing Systems (Jira, ServiceNow), System Troubleshooting, User Access Management
• SIEM, EDR & Monitoring - Splunk, Wazuh, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE), Wireshark, Nmap, TCP/IP Event Log Analysis
• Threat Analysis & Protocols - Malware Triage, Phishing Header Analysis, Rule-Based Detection, Active Directory Logs, Firewall Telemetry, VPN Logs, Threat Intelligence Integration
• Automation & Languages - Python Scripting, CrewAI Automation Framework, VS Code, Cursor Editor, REST APIs, MySQL, Linux (Kali Linux), Windows Server
• Soft Skills & Work Ethic - Logical & Analytical Thinking, Shift Flexibility, Detail-Oriented Documentation, Stakeholder Communication, Continuous Learning

EXPERIENCE & TECHNICAL TRAINING
• 09.2025 – 05.2026 | Jr Cybersecurity Analyst — SOC Operations | Wahy Labs (On-site, Kochi)
– Monitored real-time cybersecurity alert queues, triaging security events across SIEM platforms (Splunk, Wazuh) to detect unauthorized activities.
– Created, updated, and managed detailed incident tickets in the case management system, ensuring full case accuracy and evidence tracking.
– Notified internal stakeholders of security incidents, recommended mitigation steps, and followed up on remediation activities to ensure timely resolution.
– Escalated complex threat alerts to Senior Analysts with detailed investigation notes, packet analysis, and log correlation findings.
– Supported Senior Analysts in drafting Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and updating operational runbooks to enhance detector efficiency.

• 02.2025 – 07.2025 | CICSA Training — Certified IT Infrastructure & Cyber Analyst | RedTeam Hacker Academy
– Completed rigorous hands-on SOC training covering TCP/IP traffic inspection, SIEM alert parsing, and incident response procedures.
– Built Python automation scripts to parse server event logs and validate threat intelligence indicators across lab networks.

PROJECTS
• AI-Powered Autonomous Threat Detection & Case Triage Engine (Python, CrewAI, Security APIs)
Engineered an automated script that extracts log telemetry, queries threat intelligence feeds (VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB), and generates structured risk reports to streamline SOC alert triage.

• ML Security Event Log Intelligence & Anomaly Dashboard (Python, Flask, Scikit-learn)
Built a log analytics portal that ingests authentication and network telemetry, utilizing Isolation Forest algorithms to flag abnormal traffic patterns and potential exploits.

• Splunk SIEM & Security Operations Lab (Splunk Enterprise, Universal Forwarder, Linux)
Architected a centralized SIEM environment to ingest and correlate endpoint logs securely over TCP, engineering real-time detection rules and SOC dashboards to monitor simulated SSH brute-force attacks.

EDUCATION
• Master of Computer Applications (MCA) – Distance Education (Ongoing) | Sikkim Manipal University (SMU)
• Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) (2021 – 2024) | Bangalore North University, Karnataka

CERTIFICATIONS
• 09.2025 — Certified SOC Analyst v1 (CSA) — EC-Council
• 07.2025 — IT Infrastructure and SOC Analyst (CICSA) — RedTeam Hacker Academy
• CompTIA Security+ — Pursuing
